business_hours_semantics: Requests may be created while a department is closed. For business-hours services, the SLA clock starts at the next staff-response window and staff attendance is generated only inside a configured response window.

lifecycle_semantics.purpose: exercise retry, reopen, escalation, status and truthful completion behavior

distribution_note: Operational distributions intentionally include skew, long tails, SLA misses and unresolved states; derived duration/SLA fields are reconciled from event timestamps and are not tuned to look clean.
